verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a cloud research-agent platform with a Python client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out control. The docs cover only authentication, tasks, file management, agents and pricing tiers.
